name: tab-browser-ultimate
displayName: AI Browser🏆 Claude + Codex + Gemini + OpenCode + Pi + OpenRouter
description: Embedded browser tab with AI capabilities, Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi and OpenRouter integration

aiBrowser.chat.remoteTerminalShell.title: Open Plain Terminals from Chrome and the Website

aiBrowser.chat.remoteTerminalAgent.title: Open Agent Terminals from Chrome and the Website

aiBrowser.chat.exchangeKeepAwakeMinutes.title: Keep Awake After Exchange Connection
aiBrowser.chat.exchangeKeepAwakeMinutes.markdownDescription: Prevent automatic system sleep when a website viewer connects to this chat through Exchange. Each new viewer renews the timer. 0 disables this trigger; -1 keeps the computer awake until you turn it off or close the VS Code window. The display may still sleep.

aiBrowser.chat.voiceLanguage.title: Voice Message Language
aiBrowser.chat.voiceLanguage.patternErrorMessage: A language tag such as ru-RU or en-US, or empty for the Mac's own language.

scripts.compile: npm run build-ext && npm run build-webview
scripts.build-ext: npm run clean-ext && tsc --project ./tsconfig.json && node scripts/stage-terminal.mjs
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run package && ovsx publish tab-browser-ultimate.vsix
